source_checks.finding: Page opens with "If you can't connect to Wi-Fi, then check your Wi-Fi settings or troubleshoot network issues." The section "Check your Wi-Fi settings" supports each step: open Settings, tap Wi-Fi and confirm it is on, look for a blue checkmark, make sure Airplane Mode is off if you still can't connect, tap Wi-Fi again and make sure Connectivity Assist is off, restart the device if the Wi-Fi setting is dimmed, and check your router and network settings if you still see No Internet Connection. Page is for iPhone and iPad, which matches this user.

Page is the general Android internet troubleshooting article and confirms its Android Wi-Fi steps. This is a distractor: the user has an iPhone, so the Android passage does not apply to this user and is correctly unused.

required_actions.action: Confirm Wi-Fi is turned on (user already sees full Wi-Fi bars, so this is effectively done)
Look for a blue checkmark to confirm the connection
If still not connected, make sure Airplane Mode is off
Make sure Connectivity Assist is off
If the Wi-Fi setting is dimmed, restart the device
If No Internet Connection still appears, check router and network settings

source_checks.finding: Page opens with "If you can't access the Internet on your Android device, either through an app or a website, try these troubleshooting steps." The Wi-Fi section supports the steps: open Settings, tap Network & Internet or Connections, then Wi-Fi; check the Wi-Fi indicator at the top of the screen; if no bars are filled in you may be out of range, so move closer to the router, check for a stronger connection and try again; contact your internet service provider or the host of the Wi-Fi network if problems persist. The page notes that options may differ by device, which the target does not need to repeat.
Page is the iPhone and iPad Wi-Fi troubleshooting article. This is a distractor: the user has an Android phone, so the iPhone passage does not apply to this user and is correctly unused.

required_actions.action: Open Settings, tap Network & Internet or Connections, then Wi-Fi
Check the Wi-Fi indicator at the top of the screen
If no bars are filled in or the indicator is missing, move closer to the router, check for a stronger signal, and try again
If problems persist, contact the internet service provider or the host of the Wi-Fi network
